signature.name: VTask.rightInvSeq
signature.type: {B : Type u_1} -> {W : Type u_2} -> [Group W] -> {M : CoxeterMatrix B} -> (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) -> (ω : List B) -> List W

conventions.note: The right inversion sequence of the empty word is the empty list; the recursion's base case returns [] with no junk value needed.

conventions.statement: The entry for the first generator of ω (conjugated by all subsequent generators) appears first in the output; the entry for the last generator (equal to that generator itself) appears last.
conventions.note: This ordering convention distinguishes rightInvSeq from leftInvSeq.

facts.statement: ∀ {B : Type*} {W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix B} (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (i : B), VTask.rightInvSeq cs [i] = [cs.simple i]

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ (B : Type) (W : Type) [Group W] (M : CoxeterMatrix B) (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (i j : B), cs.simple i ≠ cs.simple j → VTask.rightInvSeq cs [i] ≠ [cs.simple j]
